The 19 closing times are DEP Thursday 22:00; CP1 Friday 01:30; CP2 Friday 07:00; CP3 Friday 10:30; CP4 Friday 13:00; CP6 Friday 17:30; CP7 Friday 21:00; BV1 Saturday 01:00; CP8 Saturday 06:00; CP9 Saturday 07:00; CP10 Saturday 11:30; CP11 Saturday 16:30; CP12 Saturday 20:30; BV2 Sunday 00:15; CP13 Sunday 03:00; CP14 Sunday 06:30; CP15 Sunday 09:00; CP16 Sunday 13:30; ARR Sunday 16:00.
Hell-Bourg is base 1 (BV1) at km 80.6, 995 m, with food, soup, hot meal, doctor, nurse, physiotherapy, podiatry and a drop bag.
Ilet Savannah is base 2 (BV2) at km 140.5, 133 m, with food, soup, hot meal, doctor, nurse, physiotherapy, podiatry and a drop bag.
Only Hell-Bourg, Ilet Savannah and the La Redoute finish carry the drop-bag mark.
Gîte de Bélouve at km 76.4 is a timing point with a water-only supply; Départ Sentier Scout at km 96.0 is a timing point with personal assistance but no supply.
The 13 PR points carry no cut-off time; 15 of the 16 CP points and both BV points do, while CP5 Coteau Kerveguen carries none and a water-only supply.
The Repas chaud column is marked only at CP4 Mare à Boue, BV1 Hell-Bourg, BV2 Ilet Savannah and the La Redoute finish.

The Médecin column is marked at 10 points: DEP, CP4, BV1, CP8, CP10, CP11, CP12, BV2, CP14 and ARR; the Infirmier column is marked at 15 points: DEP, CP1, CP2, CP3, CP4, CP6, BV1, CP8, CP10, CP11, CP12, BV2, CP14, CP16 and ARR.
Kiné and Podologue are marked only at BV1, BV2 and ARR; Ostéopathe only at ARR; Secouriste at DEP and ARR.
Personal assistance (Assistance personnelle) is marked O at 15 points: DEP, CP1, CP2, CP3, CP4, BV1, CP9, CP10, CP11, PR10, BV2, CP14, CP15, CP16 and ARR; every other point is marked X.
The finish is at La Redoute, km 180.8, 49 m, with a Sunday 16:00 cut-off.
